title: Japanese Yen sticks to losses against bullish USD as traders await Fed, BoJ meetings loom
summary: The USD/JPY pair sticks to a positive bias for the second straight day and trades above mid-154.00s during the Asian session on Tuesday amid a broadly firmer US Dollar (USD). Spot prices, however, lack bullish conviction as traders seem hesitant ahead of this week's key central bank events.

title: Asian stocks trade mixed, AI stocks and oil prices in focus
summary: Asian equities trade mixed on Tuesday as traders weighed Middle East tensions and calls by industry figures for a slowdown in AI development.

title: Viral hit-and-run raises road rage questions in India
